authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI-generated artifacts that warrant a lower authenticity score than initially assessed. Pig hooves are poorly defined and fade into the grass without clear cloven structure (missing parts, severity 2). Monkey tails are largely absent or indistinct; only one faint tail is visible and it appears straight rather than curly. While the overall composition is coherent and lighting is consistent, these multiple anatomical and textural defects significantly reduce authenticity. The initial score of 2.8 was too lenient given the compounding nature of these artifacts.
